52 likes, 3 comments - fortunegourmetindia on December 29, 2022: "Prosciutto di Parma, is one of the finest hams in the world. It’s a Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) food which means it’s entirely produced in the hills surrounding the town of Parma in the Emilia Romagna region of Northern Italy. This ham is characterised by its warm pink colour with a sliver of creamy fat running down one side. The meat is silky and melts in the mouth. The flavour is unbeatable: deliciously savoury with hints of sweetness and salt.

Special thanks to our sponsors, The Consorzio Del Prosciutto Di Parma @prosciuttodiparma_it✨✨

Videos sourced from @parmaham_usa
